comments.author: ddSqueeze
comments.body_html: While you can’t do this through a more straightforward json file, you can edit the properties yourself by opening the weapon script in Notepad++ (user/mods/Mass_Superi46/src/scripts/Mass_Superi/Mass_Superi.js). Good luck, though. Probably not everything will be customizable because Massivesoft likes to simply copy properties of other base EFT weapons/mods. If that’s the case for anything, you won’t be able to customize the properties without customizing the properties of the copied object.
